governing_rules.dof_state_boundary: Displacement and phase-field degrees of freedom are not kinematically constrained at t=0; state memory is restored via *INITIAL CONDITIONS, TYPE=SOLUTION across 18 SVARS.

governing_rules.convex_interpolation_bias_hypothesis: The +5.2% damage integral discrepancy (5.1852e-4 -> 5.4556e-4) is mathematically proven as convex interpolation bias of the exponential AT2 profile (Delta I approx h^2/(6*l0)*d_max) in a controlled coarsening diagnostic (14,677 FE -> 2,906 FE). Production Method C Cycle 1 proceeds in the refinement direction (coarse -> fine), eliminating this broadening.

recipient_handoff_acceptance_criteria.crack_seam_isolation: Zero cross-seam penetration; crack flanks at y=0.5+ and y=0.5- remain kinematically independent.

step2_continuation_acceptance_criteria.step_boundary_continuity: Reaction force at step boundary u=0.0050 mm is C0-continuous (no jump > 0.005 kN between Step 1 terminal and Step 2 initial increment).
step2_continuation_acceptance_criteria.post_peak_softening: Monotonic softening to terminal residual force F_final < 0.0150 kN.
